shortDescription: The Chiefs option in Polymarket’s Broncos vs. Chiefs submarket "4Q Spread -4.5" fell sharply from 51.5% one hour earlier to 23.5%, a 28% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was flagged by Catcher Predict monitoring, which noted that related breaking news may have affected the market.
